title: Review verdict
description: One schema for every reviewing role. Three roles use three vocabularies for the same three states — the architect says ALLOW / ALLOW WITH CONDITIONS / REFUSE, the registry keeper APPROVE / CONDITIONAL / REJECT, the evaluator PASS / CONDITIONAL / BLOCKED. `decision` is the canonical triple a grader reads; `decision_label` carries the role's own word so the Markdown and the JSON can be shown to agree. agents-md-schema.md rule 13.

decision.description: PASS: nothing blocks a merge. CONDITIONAL: merges once the listed findings are addressed. BLOCKED: a hard rule or a scoped ban is violated.

decision_label.description: The word the role's Markdown response used, mapped onto `decision`.

findings.description: Empty for PASS. A finding that cannot name the clause it violates is a suggestion, and belongs in `suggestions`.

why.description: The clause violated, as `<file>#<rule>` — for example `adr-conventions.md#7` or `.agents/policies/drift-patterns.md#3`.

location.description: `<path>:<line>` where the finding is anchored, when it has one site.

suggestions.description: Improvements with no clause behind them. Never a reason to withhold PASS.

checks_run.description: Every mechanical check the role was supposed to run, including the ones that did not. A check reported as `not-run` is the point of this field: a verdict resting on an unrun check must say so.

allOf.description: BLOCKED and CONDITIONAL both require at least one finding; a verdict short of PASS with an empty findings list is unactionable.
BLOCKED means at least one finding is itself blocking.
